**The capability**

What should the toolkit be able to do.

**The published source**

Every method in this toolkit traces to a citable source. If you can point
to the paper, standard, or handbook section that defines the method, the
request is much easier to evaluate and implement.

**How you would call it**

A sketch of the library call or MCP tool you would expect, with units.
